**Build's green.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the shape change in the bump:

1. `[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` — bundler now sends `retryCount`, code still read `options.retries` and threw on `undefined.toFixed`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `[retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the strict check threw on anything but `true`/`false`. Now treats `undefined` as `false`.

The rest of the output (DEP warnings, unused-export, circular-import) is just noise from the bump, unchanged, still 8 warnings — nothing left to fix there.
